title: Open dashboard and verify key metrics
description: Verify the dashboard loads with sales summary and navigation items in a fresh browser session.
steps: Open the application at http://localhost:8000
Wait for the dashboard to load
Confirm the main sales overview is visible
Confirm navigation to POS, products, invoices, customers, and reports is available

title: Create a product and keep it on stock
description: Add a product with SKU, price, and stock so it is available to sell through the POS workflow.
steps: Navigate to the products page
Add a new product with a unique SKU and barcode
Set a selling price and initial stock quantity
Save the product and verify it appears in the product list

title: Add product to POS cart and complete a cash sale
description: Validate the main sales flow: add a product, adjust quantity, collect cash payment, and finalize a sale.
steps: Open the POS screen
Search for the created product and add it to the cart
Confirm quantity and total amount are correct
Select cash payment and enter the payment amount
Complete the sale and verify the invoice is created

title: Verify inventory decreases after sale
description: Confirm a successful sale updates the product stock and inventory ledger correctly.
steps: Navigate to the inventory or product detail view
Check the sold product stock count after the sale
Verify that the movement or inventory history shows the reduction
Confirm the sale is visible in the invoices list

title: Reopen invoice and confirm saved state
description: Ensure invoice details remain persisted after the sale and are viewable later.
steps: Open the invoices screen
Find the newly created invoice
Open its detail page
Verify product lines, total, status, and payment data match the sale
